## Location And Affiliation

The Fox Lab is based in the [School of Informatics, Computing, and Cyber Systems](https://in.nau.edu/school-informatics-computing-cyber-systems/) at Northern Arizona University in Flagstaff, Arizona. Spencer J. Fox is an Assistant Professor in the school.

## Consulting And Advising

I occasionally consider consulting or technical advising related to outbreak forecasting, infectious disease modeling, forecast evaluation, and public health decision-support tools when the project is a good fit. If that is what you have in mind, send a short note about the question, timeline, available data, and intended audience.
